list: The official 55 trophies, as published for PlayStation 5 (names, descriptions and grades from the official list; 28 of the 55 are hidden on PS5 until earned).

sources.name: Exophase — GTA VI trophy list
sources.what: The official list: every trophy's name, description and grade.

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap
sources.what: Platinum roadmap: difficulty 4/10, about 200 hours, the one possibly-missable trophy, the 100% checklist.

sources.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
sources.what: Per-trophy unlock tips, story chapters, hidden flags and the 100% completion requirements.

sources.name: gta-zone — GTA 6 Trophy List

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
sources.what: PSN progress targets (the counts PlayStation tracks) for the trophies that have one.

steps.title: Play the story, take side content as it shows up
steps.text: Play through the five chapters and take optional missions and character quests as they appear. Along the way scan vehicles with the WAiNK app (200 needed for 100%), study animals with binoculars (100), meditate with both characters, and turn on every progress and collectible notification. In Chapter 1, do not skip Lucia's balcony meditation — it may be missable. Steer clear of the Irredeemable criminal profile: it is permanent. Cheats disable trophies and saving, so keep them off. There is no mission replay and no New Game+, but free roam carries on after the story.

steps.title: Finish the 100% Completion checklist
steps.text: After the credits, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work through what is left: every robbery, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations, underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks, plus 70 of the 80 challenges. The checklist is lenient — closer to 60% true completion — and everything you did during the story already counts. Nothing on it is missable.

steps.title: Strangers & Freaks and clean-up
steps.text: Stranger missions are not part of 100%, but Strangers & Freaks needs 8 strands, and several trophies come from character quest lines (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret). Finish those, then check the list for anything left.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum lands once the other 54 are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. Expect the long road: PowerPyx puts the set at 4/10 difficulty and about 200 hours, most of it on the 100% checklist behind A Long Road. One playthrough is enough, everything is single-player, and there is no mission replay, so play the story once and clean up in free roam afterwards.

source.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: A story trophy, and it cannot be missed: it pops when you finish Gone Fishing, one of the first missions of Chapter 1. Just play the opening and it is yours.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: For finishing Chapter 1. GTABase notes it actually pops once you start the first mission of Chapter 2, What's in the Bag?, so do not worry if it does not appear the instant the chapter ends. Keep playing the story and it arrives on its own.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: The Chapter 2 completion trophy. GTABase notes it is awarded as Chapter 3 begins, after the Welcome to Vice City mission, so a short delay after the chapter ends is normal.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: For finishing Chapter 3. GTABase notes it lands after the first two missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Story progress only — nothing to miss.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: For finishing Chapter 4. A straight story trophy: play through the chapter and it pops; it cannot be missed.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: For the final mission of the story, the last thing you do in Chapter 5. Free roam carries on after the credits, so everything else on the list can still be finished afterwards, and no trophy depends on how you play a mission.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: A story trophy for Breakfast Run, a Chapter 2 mission. It pops when the mission ends; nothing extra is needed and it cannot be missed.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: A story trophy for The Cartel Heist, a Chapter 3 mission. Finish the heist and the trophy follows.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: A story trophy for Child's Play, a Chapter 4 mission. Complete the mission and it pops.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: A story trophy for Headliners, a Chapter 4 mission. Finish the mission; it cannot be missed.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: A story trophy for VCIA Takedown, a Chapter 4 mission. Complete the takedown and the trophy is yours.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: A story trophy for Operation Savage Glory, a Chapter 5 mission. Finish it and the trophy pops.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the real platinum gate: the 100% Completion checklist, found under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story. Everything you did before the credits already counts, and nothing on the checklist is missable. The checklist is lenient — closer to 60% true completion, per PowerPyx. It wants every robbery in full, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 gang operations, all underwater discoveries, every Shooting Range gold medal, all drone races and Bret's 15 Target Decks, plus shares of the rest: 100 optional missions, 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animal studies, 15 of 18 meditations, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts and 100 WAiNK scans. Budget around 100 hours for this step alone.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts count, in any mix: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Flying under bridges is the quickest way to build the total, and the optional challenge on each stunt is not needed. Your count sits under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and the map can show every Stunt Spot. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past 250.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), an arcade game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race) and a stunt. Progress > Activities shows what is left, and most of these happen naturally while you play.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: A gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge: 42 golds across 12 ranges. Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger, so do them early if you can.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations — one win per location is enough for this trophy. The 100% checklist wants all 42 drone races, so you may as well finish each location while you are there.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races; there are 40 to choose from, and winning the same race again does not count. Any mix of car races, race challenges and drone races works.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui and he texts you afterwards, marking a fishing spot with a purple icon. Play through his fishing quests and beat him in his challenge.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Reach the end of any one arcade game. Three of them — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — are on the TV at home, and the fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is on arcade cabinets around Leonida.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's quests are Lucia-only and start in Chapter 3, when he texts her an address in Belville. Do all five in order — Climbing the Cellerichain, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass — and the last one awards the trophy. They are still there after the story.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton, marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento, hires you in Chapter 1 to recover treasure from 7 shipwrecks. Dive at the purple chest markers and use the metal detector to dig it up. He disappears after Chapter 1 but texts Jason again later, so you can finish it then. Track it under Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's five jobs start at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The fifth, Hometown Heroes, unlocks the trophy, and the jobs stay available after the story.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands. Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; the quest lines of Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. The remaining qualifying strands are still being confirmed, so check the trophy's progress counter in your trophy list. None of them are needed for 100%, and all of them stay available after the story.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's Wish List opens after the Chapter 3 mission that gets you the Key Cloner (Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS). Deliver the 16 sports cars on his list to his garage in west Vice City (RK icon). Scan cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list; hotel driveways around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach are the best places to look, and cars in better condition pay more.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Jason-only. After Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3, Tyrone has you destroy the synthetic labs marked in purple around Vice City. Once enough are gone, his last job, Shut Down the Labs, awards the trophy.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every Meditation Spot until the counter reaches 18; meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice. The last one needs both characters, which is possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. POSSIBLY MISSABLE: in Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1, and it is not confirmed yet whether the trophy needs it — so do not skip it. PowerPyx flags the same warning: this first meditation is the only possibly-missable moment in the game.

source.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting quests start after Coffee Break in Chapter 2: he texts Jason, and Veteran Hunted in Lummox County kicks things off. Hunt the animals on his Target Decks (purple icons) and bring them back as Jason. A clean one-shot kill pays more but is not required. Which animal triggers the trophy is not confirmed yet; the 100% checklist needs all 15 Target Decks anyway.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets; you do not need all of them. The Collections section of the Progress menu shows how close each set is.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the WAiNK phone app (hold Up on the D-pad, then R1 / RB). Any 100 count, from the 31 Landmarks, 35 Curiosities, 23 Sculptures and the No Flusher tags.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 of the 80 Challenges; Progress > Challenges marks finished ones with a tick. Many complete themselves while you play, and the 100% checklist needs 70, so this one comes along the way.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Possible once both characters are together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. Call your partner (hold Right on the D-pad, then Triangle / Y), get a 4-star Wanted Level and escape — it only counts once you are out of the red heat zone. The train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County shakes off cops and helicopters well, and bank vault robberies always give 4 stars, so it often unlocks there.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row while you are still wanted (flashing red and blue). Go in with body armor, sticky bombs and healing items. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City — open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 — are close together. The trophy can take about 30 seconds to appear after the third shop; if it does not, rob a fourth.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 different vehicles with the WAiNK app; you do not need to drive them. Stand next to a busy road and scan passing traffic. The 100% checklist needs 200 base models, so you will get this anyway.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single Combat Focus (click both sticks while aiming). It only lasts a few seconds, so fill your Focus first — eat, drink or wash up at home; Adrenaline makes it last longer — and use an assault rifle. Gang operation thugs work well; cops, soldiers and civilians do not seem to count.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, steal one of the big passenger jets docked at a departure gate's boarding bridge — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. Back it out, take off and get about 1 km away from the airport. Gates E3 and E4 are the easiest: drive through the airfield fence and use the door by the stairs next to the boarding bridge.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station on the southwest island of Mariana County — the tanks are at the south end of the base — and take out enemies from inside it until the trophy pops.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 give you the Snap Gun. Use it on a jewelry store's locked back door — kicking it in sets off the alarm — find the note with the safe code in the back room and empty the safe without being spotted. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City works well.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Bank vaults open up with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is…. Follow a security van to its bank and get into the vault while it is open. The haul is too heavy for one character, so hand a bag to your partner. Vaults always give 4 stars: escape on a fast bike, then switch vehicles. 5 of the 8 vaults are enough here, but the 100% checklist needs all 8, and each pays up to $205,000. Yasmani sells van tips for $10,000.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Robbing a bank vault counts for this one (see Maximum Withdrawal), as long as you then escape the red heat zone or get to a Pay 'n' Spray. Before that, you can box in an armored truck, put a sticky bomb on its back doors, blow them open and get away.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Clear the fog from the whole map of Leonida. The quickest way is by plane, flying over every dark patch until the map is fully revealed.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal gang operation (yellow map icons) from each of the 9 gangs; Progress > Gangs keeps count. The 100% checklist needs all 39.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City. GTABase lists the exact steps as not yet confirmed — the description points to a cocktail with a view, and the method will be pinned down as players find it. Check the source link for updates.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: The description points to crashing a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom, in classic GTA style. GTABase lists the exact steps as not yet confirmed, so treat this as the lead to test rather than a finished method, and check the source link for updates.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn is a gang operation, first marked by Hit Kingpin Bowling in Chapter 2. Take its three valuables: the luxury watch in the southeast office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the northeast table and the safe in the northeast hallway (bring sticky bombs). The trophy pops once you lose the police. You do not need all three in one visit, but the robbery takes a long time to come back.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Max out Strength for both Jason and Lucia (Jason & Lucia > Strength in the pause menu). Work out at fitness clubs (Map > Activities) with your partner along: training one trains the other too. After the story you can also train at home.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Most players get it without trying; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI to watch the count. Do not push towards the Irredeemable profile: it is permanent.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. GTABase lists the exact steps as not yet confirmed — the description is the only lead so far, and the method will be pinned down as players find it. Check the source link for updates.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Expect a strange event or Easter egg somewhere in Leonida. GTABase lists the exact steps as not yet confirmed; the description is the only lead, so watch for odd encounters while exploring, and check the source link for updates.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle — a melee drive-by. GTABase lists the exact steps as not yet confirmed, so the wording of the description is the lead for now; check the source link for updates.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) in Chapter 3 gets you the Dye Pack Jammer. Rob banks and Payday Loans, then sell the marked bills to fences; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It is a running total, so the robberies for 100% get you there.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: A running total of $100,000 across every kind of shop. Guns, car mods and tattoos use it up fastest.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy the 8 garages for sale in the Vice City Real Estate phone app (available after Daily Driver in Chapter 2), about $160,000 in total. The 4 garages the story gives you do not count.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Moses' Chapter 2 mission gets you the Scooter Bros app. Take stolen vehicles to his garage in Port Gellhorn, respray them and register them. At first he only takes cars without trackers; from Chapter 3, any Pay 'n' Spray registers tracked ones. You need free garage space (see Little Boxes) and each registration costs money, so use cheap cars and bikes.

source.name: GTABase — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Achievements List
